changes.description: Move the required CSS and licensed fonts into web/styles; maintain blog DOM/CSS/font identifiers locally.

Apply compact administration geometry from isarmg/zxs commit 8c062902a995e23551662bcf1a723f0c78b5cedd while retaining the public stylesheet layout and surface extents; preserve original CSS/font receipts and unchanged licensed font bytes. Curve reference archive: compliance/interface-reference/zxs-interface.snapshot.tar.gz.

Remove administration rules from the public stylesheet, isolate shared-name public rules, use explicit row/check roles, align populated table actions, Markdown and media previews with shared geometry, and preserve usable native selector fallbacks and authentication feedback.

Require explicit layout and frame roles, separate nested form and rich-content surfaces with shared 18px clearance, preserve transparent table scrolling and flush text surfaces, and restore administrative keyboard focus indicators and theme-colored action links.

Use the reference compact 36px working-row geometry for administrative single-line inputs, retaining the shared 18px frame clearance, multiline writing areas and independent authentication/header targets. Match 34px table-row actions with inherited row typography and prevent wrapped action labels from increasing single-line control height.
Keep compact navigation and comfortable header actions aligned to the first row through wrapping, using start alignment and an inset derived from the existing row-height tokens.

Replace exterior rectangular focus outlines on managed administration fields with the existing one-pixel contour in the theme focus color. Preserve control geometry, native checkbox/button indicators, independent authentication and public styles, and system Highlight in forced colors. Remove the terminal header separator on empty tables so it does not stack with the unchanged outer frame; retain populated-table header separators.
